strings.homeMcp: MCP (Model Context Protocol) yana ba da damar mataimakan AI masu jituwa su haɗa zuwa kayan aikin waje. Poly-Glot yana fallasa gano samfuri, ginin gaggawa, da shirye-shiryen kwatance. Shirya kwatance baya tuntuɓar masu samar da AI da aka zaɓa ta atomatik ko dawo da amsoshinsu.
strings.claudeAccess: Samuwar haɗin haɗin al'ada na Claude ya dogara da shirin ku na Claude na yanzu, sigar app, da izinin sararin aiki. Yi amfani da Saituna → Masu haɗawa idan akwai.
strings.chatIntro: Haɗa Poly-Glot azaman ƙa'idar MCP mai nisa ko mai haɗawa ta al'ada lokacin da asusun ChatGPT ɗinku ke goyan bayansa ko filin aiki. Samuwar da izini sun dogara da tsarin ku da saitunanku.
strings.chatStep1: Duba ChatGPT Apps ko saitunan masu haɓakawa
strings.chatStep1Body: Buɗe aikace-aikacen da ke akwai ko tsarin MCP na al'ada a cikin ChatGPT. Shirinku, filin aiki, da mai gudanarwa na iya taƙaita wannan fasalin.
strings.chatStep2: Ƙara wurin ƙarshen HTTP mai gudana mai gudana
strings.chatStep2Body: Lokacin da asusunku yana goyan bayan sabar MCP mai nisa na al'ada, samar da ainihin URL ɗin da ke ƙasa kuma kammala duk wani tabbaci da ake buƙata.
strings.chatStep3: Yarda da kayan aikin kuma tabbatar da shiga
strings.chatStep3Body: Sake sabunta kayan aikin da aka gano kuma gwada samun_language_options ko search_templates. Shiga tare da ingantattun asusun Poly-Glot don kunna gwaji, Aika ayyuka, da samun shiga. (get_language_options)
strings.chatNoteBody: Samun damar kayan aiki ya dogara da abokin ciniki da izini. GUI da aka haɗa sararin aiki bazai iya bayarwa a kowane abokin ciniki na MCP ba. Poly-Glot baya yin alƙawarin jeri na Store Store ko shigarwa ta danna sau ɗaya ta atomatik.
strings.chatHelpLink: Karanta matsala na ChatGPT MCP na yanzu →
strings.toolGetTemplate: Sami filayen samfuri; Ana mayar da gawarwakin da aka biya da sauri ne kawai lokacin da asusun ya cancanci
strings.compareExample: Kayan aikin shirya_compare ya dawo da sauri guda ɗaya da shirin ChatGPT, Claude, da Gemini. Ba ya kiran waɗannan masu samarwa kai tsaye ko tattara amsoshinsu; yi amfani da kowane zaɓaɓɓen AI kuma kwatanta sakamakon da kanka. (prepare_compare)
strings.freeAnswer: Gwajin cikakken isa na kwanaki 3 da aikace-aikacen ke farawa a farkon cancantar Aika bayan tabbatar da asusun kuma baya juyewa kai tsaye zuwa biyan kuɗi da aka biya. Bayan ya ƙare, samfuran kyauta 25 da Aika-AI guda ɗaya a kowace sa'o'i 24 masu birgima suna nan; Kwatanta Yanayin, BYOM, kayan aikin sarrafa harshe, da samfuran Pro suna buƙatar gwaji mai aiki ko biyan kuɗi na Pro.
strings.appAnswer: Kuna iya bincika kayan aikin MCP kyauta daga abokin ciniki masu jituwa. Fara gwajin da amfani da ƙayyadaddun kayan aikin yana buƙatar ingantacciyar asusun Poly-Glot, kuma siyan kuɗin Apple ko maidowa na iya buƙatar ƙa'idar ta asali. Tallafin abokin ciniki na MCP da wadatar GUI da aka haɗa sun bambanta.
strings.privacyAnswer: Sabar ta MCP tana aiwatar da buƙatun kayan aiki kuma tana yin rikodin metadata na amfani da aiki. Samfurin na yau da kullun da kayan aikin jiwuwa na iya aika abun ciki da aka bayar ga zaɓaɓɓen mai ba da sarrafawa. Kar a haɗa da sirrika a cikin buƙatun tallafi ko bayanan jama'a. Bitar da
strings.privacyCollection: Za a iya adana tarihin ƙa'ida da saitunan akan na'urarka. Lokacin da kake amfani da sabis na AI da aka haɗa ko uwar garken MCP na Poly-Glot, ana aika buƙatun zuwa sabis ɗin da aka zaɓa. MCP na baya yana tabbatar da haƙƙin asusu kuma yana yin rikodin metadata na aiki kamar amfanin kayan aiki da kurakurai; ana buƙatar asusun shiga don kunna gwaji da ƙuntataccen ayyukan Aika. Kar a ƙaddamar da kalmomin shiga, maɓallan API, ko rasidu masu zaman kansu a cikin saƙonnin tallafi.
strings.privacyPurchases: Apple yana aiwatar da biyan kuɗin biyan kuɗi na cikin-app. Poly-Glot na iya tantancewa da yin rikodin yanayin haƙƙin biyan kuɗi ko masu gano ma'amalar Apple don tantance damar fasalin; Apple ne ke sarrafa bayanan katin biyan kuɗi, ba ta wannan gidan yanar gizon ba.
strings.privacyServices: Wannan gidan yanar gizon yana amfani da Google Analytics da TikTok pixel talla. Maziyartan gidan yanar gizon suna iya samun bayanan bincike da ma'amala da waɗannan ayyuka ke sarrafa su ƙarƙashin manufofinsu. Masu ba da AI, zaɓi na zaɓi na ƙarshe na ƙirar ƙira, sabis na gane magana, da masu samar da sauti/rubutu na iya aiwatar da abun ciki lokacin da kuka zaɓi aika shi. Sharuɗɗan keɓancewar su suna aiki.
strings.termsWhat: In native-app workflows, Poly-Glot iya ku dacewa da kuma za a kan fasaha, da haka ya zama AI provider ta selected. MCP na'urorin za a iya aiki da kuma sauri daga cikin remote server wanda ya yi amfani da abokan ciniki da kuma samar da ƙarfin kayayyakin. Sa'an yanar da kuma kayayyakin ya ce ne mai amfani da wani service da kuma workflow.
strings.termsCompare: Yadda za a iya da wani samfurin tare da mai kyau AI don kayayyakin, kuma samar da yanarwa daga cikin ƙasa aiki. The MCP prepar_compare tool ne sa'an aiki da samar da samfurin da kuma za a kan yanar. (prepare_compare)
strings.termsTrial: The app-managed 3-day full-access na'urorin zafi a cikin farko kwarewa Sunan da akafin kayayyakin; sa'an zafi ne ya ce da hakar da kuma ba mai amfani da wani abokan ciniki. Sa'an aiki da kuma kayayyakin shi ne mai amfani da wani sabon bincike a kan wannan alama.
strings.termsGated: Sa'an kamfanoni-tallace, wannan kayayyakin za a iya wani Pro abokan ciniki; A kan Your Own Model da kuma MCP aiki tare da ƙarfi ne mai amfani:
strings.termsPrivacy: Sunan tafiya da kuma ƙarfin za a iya sa'an aiki, amma mahimmanci daga samar da karantawa AI da farashin MCP kayayyakin za ka yi amfani da wannan kayayyaki. Poly-Glot's MCP server ya ce da akaun hakar da kayayyakin aiki metadata; custom model da kuma transcription workflows zai iya sauri don ƙasawa a tsarin processors. The website yana da amfani da analytics da kuma reklam pixels. Yadda za a kan Privacy Policy da kuma tsaya'antu ta hanyar.
strings.pricingPrivacy: App History da kuma Settings yana iya sa'an aiki. Sa'an halitta da aka sa'an AI don amfani, a lokacin da farashin MCP ta hanyar Poly-Glot server. The MCP service ya ce da kuma kayan aiki amfani metadata; processing samfurin yanar da wani Privacy Policy.
strings.pricingVoice: Voice input iya amfani da on-device na'urorin yanayin, tare da wani server based fallback ta hanyar don device da kuma tsarin. The MCP transcribe_audio tool sends supplied audio to its configured transcription provider and requires active trial or Pro access.
strings.pricingTrial: The app-managed 3-day full-access tafiya yana da farko kwarewa Salin for a kudin akafi. Wannan ne mai sauke a cikin bayar da Apple abokan ciniki. Za a kan tsari da kuma za ka yi amfani da kayan abokan ciniki ya ce wani aka'antu ta hanyar account verification.
strings.pricingExpired: Sa'an tsari, 25 free templates za a iya sauke, tare da wani single-AI Send ta hanyar free workflows a lokacin 24 hours. Pro templates, Comparare Mode, BYOM execution da MCP language-processing kayayyakin za a iya wani pro ko Pro; the trial itself mai ba tare da bayar abokan ciniki.
strings.compareHow: Poly-Glot za a iya samar da wani kofein jikiwa tare da samfurin don amfani. The app ta amfani da samfurin yanar sa'an yanar, wanda ya ce ga abokan ciniki da kuma aiki na wuri za a iya. The MCP prepar_compare tool fases prompts da kuma samar da samfurin tafiya; za a iya sa'an takardar modeli ko ka yi amfani da yanar. (prepare_compare)
strings.compareAuto: Ƙungiyar Yadda za a iya amfani da wani AI providers. In a MCP client, prepar_compare ya yi amfani da wani samfurin plan ko ba tare da samar da samar. Sa'an, sa'an da kuma sa'anin yanar da wani yanar ya ce ta hanyar wannan app ko client da kuma a kan samfurin. (prepare_compare)
strings.templatesFree: Yana da 25 wani free templates. Surfing da kuma searching ne mai amfani da kayayyakin; ƙarfin Pro template bodies za a iya sa'an kawai kada akafi ya ce da pro ma'aikacewa. Bayan 3 daga tsari, free templates yana da kayayyakin amma Pro templates da kuma Comparare Mode Lock.
strings.templatesPro: No pay abokan ciniki ne mai amfani da sauke ko amfani da limitated free tier. A kan aka'antu ya ce da za ka iya kafa a cikin tsari ko amfani da ƙarfin Sunan aiki. Pro za a iya amfani da limitated templates, Comparare Mode da kuma unlimited sends, plus kwangarin BYOM da MCP language-processing.
strings.languagesCount: Poly-Glot yana da 38 na'urorin yanar, ciki har da sauri a kan Arabic da Hebrew, da kuma abokan ciniki kayan aiki. MCP language detection, translation, lokalization da kuma transcription ne wani abokan ciniki kayan aiki wanda ya ce a cikin al'adin ko Pro abokin ciniki.
strings.mcpIntro: Poly-Glot ya ce a hotuna Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol server tare da kayan aiki ga samfurin bincike, prompt building, comparison preparation, BYOM, language and audio processing, kuma abokan ciniki status. Sauke-tuntun da aka tsayawa don sauke a kan shaida; Sunan da kuma ƙarfin kayan aiki amfani da kudin server-side hakki.
strings.mcpCount: The current MCP server code registers 15 kayayyakin: 7 kayan kayan aiki, 4 BYOM kayayyaki, da kuma 4 language da kuma audio kayayyaka. Discovery ya ce a kan customer support da kuma ƙarfi; kai aiki na kayan aiki za ka iya wani al'authentified trial ko Pro account.
